parsed.explanation: Parent regime imposes tier-1 exposures: binary passport policy, visa refusal and possible lifetime fraud finding on sex-discrepancy, federal single-sex facility exclusion, and documented national custody harms, with state threat-framing, though courts have blocked some orders. This state/province materially mitigates locally: no mapped bathroom ban, city self-identification facility access, single-occupancy neutral restrooms, gender-identity discrimination banned since 2006, hate-crime enhancements since 2016, and a 2023 shield law protecting visiting patients/providers. It cannot override national entry, passports, federal facilities or national custody, per secondary factors, so the harshest federal exposure caps the rating above the national average but well below a low-risk jurisdiction.
